svg.title: 3.5 FieldStationsPage
svg.desc: Wireframes for the Field Stations page with the current release and its download, the station table with version, last sync, queue depth and outdated badges, the create, one-time credential and revoke dialogs, the limit, release and empty states, and the 360 pixel mobile layouts. Illustrative sample data, not live records.
svg.text: Route /o/field-stations | Org Manager (Operator reads) | Desktop view above, dialogs, states and 360 px mobile below
TanNB | SD | 29 Oct 2026 | Illustrative API sample data (api-design 23 to 26); alternate states are separate views.
Download the release and replace the executable on the laptop. Check the SHA-256 after downloading.
1 of 3 active stations runs an older version. Download 1.2.0 and replace its executable.
A Field Station keeps its queue on the laptop. After a revoke, queued events are delivered once a new credential is configured.
At 5 of 5 Create Field Station is disabled. An Org Operator sees no Create or Revoke. The sample SHA-256 is truncated.
Where the laptop runs, for example.

its cache lasts up to 60 seconds. Events the station still
holds are delivered once a new credential is configured.
